breakdown.title: Working
breakdown.exact: Atomic masses from the data sheet, unrounded
breakdown.perElement: Each atomic mass rounded to {{mode}} before multiplying
breakdown.unstable: Numbers in brackets: mass number of the most stable isotope

rounding.title: Rounding
rounding.perElementHelp: Off: the sum is rounded once at the end. On: each atomic mass is rounded before it is multiplied by the count.
rounding.perElementExact: Does not apply when the result is shown exactly.

errors.lowercase: “{{sym}}” needs a capital first letter – did you mean “{{suggestion}}”? (character {{pos}})
errors.numberWithoutElement: A number on its own is not a formula – add an element after it (character {{pos}})
errors.incompleteHydrate: Missing formula after the hydrate dot (character {{pos}})
errors.chargeNotAtEnd: A charge (+ or −) must come at the very end (character {{pos}})
errors.noArrow: Missing reaction arrow – write → or -> between the two sides
errors.twoArrows: Only one reaction arrow is allowed (character {{pos}})
errors.emptySide: Both sides of the arrow need at least one substance
errors.oneSide: {{sym}} only appears on one side – check the formulas
errors.cannotBalance: This equation cannot be balanced – check the formulas
errors.multipleSolutions: This equation can be balanced in more than one way – it contains independent reactions

amount.title: Amount of substance
amount.intro: Fill in two of the three values and the third is calculated.
amount.formulaHelp: Fills in M automatically using your rounding.
amount.needTwo: Fill in two of the three values.
amount.tooMany: All three are filled in – clear the one you want to calculate.
amount.exactQuotient: A division rarely has an exact answer – shown to 6 significant figures.
amount.tooSmall: Too small for the chosen decimal places – shown to 3 significant figures.

percent.title: Mass percent
percent.intro: How much of the mass each element makes up.

empirical.title: Empirical formula
empirical.intro: From mass percent or grams to the simplest formula, step by step.
empirical.step1: 1. Divide by molar mass: n = m / M
empirical.step3: 3. Multiply by {{k}} and round to whole numbers
empirical.fuzzy: The ratios are not close to whole numbers – check the values you entered.
empirical.sumWarning: The percentages add up to {{sum}} %, not 100 %.
empirical.needRows: Fill in at least one element.

more.title: More
more.aboutText: Atomic masses are taken from the “Grunnstoffenes periodesystem” sheet in the REA3046 exam, exactly as printed. The sum is calculated with integers, so the result never picks up floating-point rounding errors.
more.offline: Works offline after the first visit. Choose “Add to Home Screen” in your browser to get it as an app icon.
more.percentDesc: Share of the mass per element
more.concDesc: c = n/V, mass for a solution and dilution

quiz.description: Practise molar mass with answer options based on common mistakes.

sum.help: Write the substances as a sum: Na + Cl + O × 2. Use × or * for a count and − to subtract. Each term can be an element or a whole formula.

reaction.title: Chemical equation
reaction.intro: Type a reaction and it is balanced. Enter a mass to work out the rest.
reaction.check: Check: the same number of atoms on each side
reaction.stoichIntro: Enter the mass of one or more substances. With two reactants the limiting one is found.
reaction.badNumber: Invalid number in one of the masses.

conc.title: Concentration
conc.introC: Fill in what you know and the rest is worked out. With a formula or M you can go via the mass.
conc.introD: Fill in three of the four values and the last is worked out.
conc.sameUnit: V₁ and V₂ must use the same unit (both mL or both L).
conc.needTwo: Fill in at least two values.
conc.nothingToSolve: Nothing to work out – clear the field you want to find.
conc.needThree: Fill in three of the four values.
conc.tooMany: All four are filled in – clear the one you want to work out.
